pages.quiz:
FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

2. When practising Grammar, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Grammar.

3. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Excuse me
   B. Good night only
   C. Thank you
   D. Good morning / hello

4. When practising Reading for Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Vocabulary.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Vocabulary.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Vocabulary.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Vocabulary.

5. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.

6. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.

7. When practising Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension.

8. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. fenêtre
   B. livre
   C. chaise
   D. porte

9. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
